purpose: Painted material textures for seven production age UI themes

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flat painted material texture for borders of a high-quality historical RTS user interface. Primary request: one opaque material surface filling the entire square image, viewed exactly straight-on with no perspective. Painterly realistic game-art finish, richly tactile at close range, visually calm at small UI sizes. Soft diffuse light from upper-left, evenly exposed. Seamless-looking surface with the same detail and brightness at all four edges. This is a raw texture, not a UI mockup or a picture of an object. No frame, borders, labels, text, symbols, rivets, separate objects, dramatic shadows or vignette. No transparent pixels. Material: weathered gray granite cut-stone face, coarse small mineral speckles, shallow chisel wear and occasional fine cracks, matte, earthy gray with warmer pale speckles. No mortar lines or separate stones.

edits.editBrief: Larger fractured rock faces, chipped irregular edges, deep charcoal crevices and restrained moss; straight-on opaque painted fieldstone material for small UI rims. Keep gray stone dominant and retain quiet text inlays in the assembled UI.
